name: PR Review
description: Review a newly opened pull/merge request. Posts inline comments and a summary review, then sets the PR's draft/ready state from the verdict — a clean review marks it ready for review, blocking issues leave it as a draft (GitHub only; on GitLab the state step is inert).

workflows.name: PR Review
workflows.description: Reads the pull/merge request diff, posts inline comments where appropriate, leaves a summary review, and flips the PR's draft/ready state to match the verdict (ready for review when clean, draft when changes are needed).

nodes.name: Review
nodes.instructionsAppend: A pull/merge request has just been opened. Read its metadata from the trigger context. Submit your review with COMMENT state only via the connected MCP server. Treat your review as the readiness verdict: if you find no blocking issues the pull request is ready for human review, otherwise it should stay (or return to) a draft — the final writeback step sets that draft/ready state for you. Read local guidance such as CLAUDE.md or CONTRIBUTING.md when present.
